title: Part Three: Armistice Lines and the Sinai Test

sections.brief: The four 1949 armistice agreements and their no-border clauses (Egypt Art. V, Lebanon on the international line with 13 villages returned, Jordan Art. II, Syria DMZs 'no relation whatsoever to ultimate territorial arrangements'); 78%; Sharett 'provisional boundaries' and Lausanne; Ben-Gurion's 'Jewish state without the entire land' (via Olmert 2006) and Morris via Kramer; Za'im 1949; Herut's 'both banks' programme (14 seats, 11.5%) and Jordan's 1950 'two banks' annexation; DMZ pressure (Dayan 1953 FRUS) and infiltration years; fact/pattern/argument. Figures: compare; stats

Sinai 1956 as the test: Sèvres 'fantastic' plan and eighth point (Shlaim); 'Third Kingdom' checked — not in the 7 Nov Knesset speech (JVL/MFA text), traced to the letter read at Sharm el-Sheikh (Walla 2023; Avnery); 8 Nov 'never planned to annex the Sinai desert'; Gaza retention Dec 1956–Jan 1957; Res. 1124, aide-mémoire, Eisenhower 20 Feb 1957, Meir 1 March, out by 8 March; two readings; links to cw3. Figures: time; compare
